CLAUSE: the amplitude at a site advances in that site's own time, giving the generator w H, similar to the hermitian H_w = sqrt(w) H sqrt(w), conserved sum |psi_x|^2/w_x. ESTABLISHED: in a uniform gradient H_w^n T_a = lambda_a^n T_a H_w^n exactly (force = -(energy) x grad u in every state); rays of E = w(x) eps(k) obey dv_j/dt = -w^2 sum_l d_j d_l(eps^2/2) d_l u + 2 (v.grad u) v_j, which for the walk is -w^2 cos(2 k_j) d_j u + 2 (v.grad u) v_j whatever the rest energy; EXECUTED, NOT PROVED: packets follow clouds of rays to 5 parts in 10^4 (line) and 2 parts in 10^3 (three dimensions), and they also drift SIDEWAYS along (gradient) x (motion) by g T/(2k) (measured -0.119 and -0.227 against 0.120 and 0.240), which no ray has.
